ideas.pitch: A lightweight VS Code extension that streams BossConsole agent execution states, tool calls, and error traces directly into the editor sidebar.
ideas.title: BossConsole VS Code Extension for Real-Time Agent Telemetry
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the developer-experience upgrade category in BossConsole directly appeals to judges looking for tools that improve daily open-source usability and ecosystem growth.

ideas.pitch: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes MariaDB schema introspection and query execution safely to BossConsole AI agents.
ideas.title: BossConsole MCP Bridge for MariaDB
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings high-demand database tool use to the multi-platform harness, giving agents immediate enterprise data retrieval capabilities.

ideas.pitch: A visual drag-and-drop workflow builder that exports standard BPMN 2.0 XML directly executable as multi-agent pipelines inside BossConsole.
ideas.title: BPMN Visual Workflow Generator for BossConsole Agents
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven architectural patterns from UiPath AgentHack winning projects by integrating enterprise process management with autonomous agents.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router middleware that intercepts agent prompts and tool outputs to block unauthorized system actions or hallucinations.
ideas.title: Semantic Guardrails Middleware for BossConsole
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering in agent governance and security, which consistently impresses technical open-source maintainer judges.

ideas.pitch: An edge-running code reviewer integration for BossConsole utilizing local models and NPUs to audit pull requests completely offline.
ideas.title: Offline Local Code Reviewer Plugin for BossConsole
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses privacy-conscious enterprise users by adding local execution capabilities to the multi-platform agent harness.
